feature.label: GAMA Developer Tools
feature.description: Tools for the developers of GAMA, available in a "GAMA" menu of the Eclipse IDE: wizards for new GAMA plugins (standard layout, annotation processor configured, integration in the build), skills, operators, actions, types and test models; a dialog-free "Clean and Rebuild" that resets the annotation processor; a configuration checker with quick fixes; a report of undocumented and untested GAML elements; the rebuild of the processor jar and a package dependency graph.
